goal: Scaffold the project and build the Tahoe desktop shell: Liquid Glass design system, transparent menu bar + menus, Dock, desktop/wallpaper, window manager, Spotlight, Control Center, theming store, persistence hook, and the app-registry interface that all later apps plug into.
summary: Phase 1 (Foundation & Desktop Shell) complete. The Tahoe desktop shell is fully scaffolded and the shell layer is functional end-to-end: (1) Vite 8 + React 19 + TS 6 + Tailwind v4 (CSS-first @theme tokens) project with oxlint/Vitest(jsdom)/Playwright(chromium) tooling all green. (2) Liquid Glass design system — GlassPanel/Dock/MenuBar components with backdrop-blur+saturate translucency, specular top-edge highlights, soft shadows; MenuBar is intentionally fully transparent per Tahoe. (3) Window manager — Zustand store (open/close/focus/minimize/restore/toggleMaximize/setBounds, monotonic zCounter, topmost-refocus on close/minimize) + WindowChrome (traffic-light controls, drag, double-click zoom) + Window (8-edge resize, app mounting via registry). (4) Desktop shell — Wallpaper (4 bundled gradients), transparent MenuBar with Apple menu + per-app menus reflecting the focused app (hover-switch, click-toggle, click-away/Esc close, action→window-manager resolution), Dock with framer-motion fisheye magnification + running indicators. (5) Spotlight (Cmd+Space, app filtering, Arrow/Enter/click launch, Esc/click-away close) + Control Center (Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/AirDrop/Focus toggles + Brightness/Volume sliders mutating a Zustand system store) + StatusBar (Spotlight/CC triggers + live clock). (6) Theming store (Light/Dark/Auto via matchMedia, 8 accent colors, tinted/clear icon style, wallpaper) persisted to localStorage via a generic usePersistentState hook, applied live to <html> (data-theme/data-appearance/data-accent/data-icon-style + --accent var) and surviving page.reload(). (7) App-registry interface (registerApp/getApp/listApps) with 4 stub apps. Verification: lint 0 errors, build ✓, 15/15 unit tests, 43/43 e2e across 6 spec files (shell smoke, window-manager, menubar, spotlight, control-center, appearance). Stub apps (Finder/Calculator/Notes/Test) and the System Settings appearance UI are intentionally deferred to later phases — the registry + theme-store contracts they need are complete.
stepSummaries:
1. Scaffold Vite + React + TS + Tailwind; install Zustand, lucide-react, framer-motion; configure Vitest (unit), Playwright (e2e), ESLint; create the Tahoe design tokens (colors, typography, radii) in Tailwind config. [verified]
  2. Build the Liquid Glass design system: reusable GlassPanel/Dock/MenuBar components using backdrop-blur + saturate + layered translucency + specular highlights; system-font typography stack. [verified]
  3. Implement the window manager Zustand store + Window/WindowChrome components: open/close/focus/minimize/restore, drag, resize, z-order, traffic-light controls; per-window app mounting via the registry. [verified]
  4. Build desktop + wallpaper, the fully transparent menu bar with Apple menu and per-app menus reflecting the focused app, and the Dock with app icons, running indicators, and hover magnification. [verified]
  5. Build Spotlight (Cmd+Space, app/action filtering, Enter launches) and Control Center (Wi-Fi/Bluetooth toggles, Brightness/Volume sliders mutating a system store), plus the app-registry/launcher contract. [verified]
  6. Implement the theming store (Light/Dark/Auto, accent color, icon style tinted/clear, wallpaper) and a usePersistentState hook over localStorage; wire appearance to the shell and verify it persists across reload. [verified]
